sentences.en: We use olive oil to cook this salad.
sentences.zh: 我们用橄榄油做这道沙拉。

sentences.en: My favorite dressing is made with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的酱料是橄榄油和黑醋调制的。

sentences.en: The restaurant uses only extra virgin olive oil for their cooking.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅只用特级初榨橄榄油烹饪。

senses.zh: 橄榄油（用于烹饪和凉拌色拉）
